commandMenuItem.label: Remove from Favorites
commandMenuItem.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: arrayLength(favoriteRecordIds) == numberOfSelectedRecords and noneDefined(selectedRecords, "deletedAt") and not hasAnySoftDeleteFilterOnView and objectMetadataItem.nameSingular != "messageCampaign" and objectMetadataItem.nameSingular != "workflow"

commandMenuItem.label: Navigate to next {objectLabelSingular}
commandMenuItem.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: pageType == "RECORD_PAGE" and not isInSidePanel and objectMetadataItem.nameSingular != "messageCampaign" and objectMetadataItem.nameSingular != "agentChatThread"

commandMenuItem.label: Merge {objectLabelPlural}
commandMenuItem.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: not isSelectAll and numberOfSelectedRecords >= 2 and not objectMetadataItem.isSystem and objectMetadataItem.nameSingular != "workflow" and objectMetadataItem.nameSingular != "dashboard" and objectPermissions.canUpdateObjectRecords and objectPermissions.canDestroyObjectRecords and numberOfSelectedRecords <= 9 and noneEquals(selectedRecords, "recordPermissions.canUpdate", false) and noneEquals(selectedRecords, "recordPermissions.canDelete", false)

commandMenuItem.label: Create {objectLabelSingular}
commandMenuItem.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: pageType == "INDEX_PAGE" and objectPermissions.canCreateObjectRecords and not hasAnySoftDeleteFilterOnView and objectMetadataItem.isUICreatable and objectMetadataItem.isUIEditable and not objectMetadataItem.isRemote

commandMenuItem.label: Import {objectLabelPlural}
commandMenuItem.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: pageType == "INDEX_PAGE" and not hasAnySoftDeleteFilterOnView and permissionFlags.IMPORT_CSV

commandMenuItem.label: Delete {objectLabel}
commandMenuItem.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: numberOfSelectedRecords >= 1 and not hasAnySoftDeleteFilterOnView and objectPermissions.canSoftDeleteObjectRecords and (isSelectAll or noneDefined(selectedRecords, "deletedAt")) and (isSelectAll or noneEquals(selectedRecords, "recordPermissions.canSoftDelete", false))

commandMenuItem.label: Add to Favorites
commandMenuItem.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: arrayLength(favoriteRecordIds) < numberOfSelectedRecords and noneDefined(selectedRecords, "deletedAt") and not hasAnySoftDeleteFilterOnView and objectMetadataItem.nameSingular != "messageCampaign" and objectMetadataItem.nameSingular != "workflow"

commandMenuItem.label: Merge with Another {objectLabelSingular}
commandMenuItem.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: pageType == "RECORD_PAGE" and numberOfSelectedRecords == 1 and noneDefined(selectedRecords, "deletedAt") and not objectMetadataItem.isSystem and objectMetadataItem.nameSingular != "workflow" and objectMetadataItem.nameSingular != "dashboard" and objectPermissions.canUpdateObjectRecords and objectPermissions.canDestroyObjectRecords and noneEquals(selectedRecords, "recordPermissions.canUpdate", false) and noneEquals(selectedRecords, "recordPermissions.canDelete", false)

commandMenuItem.label: Restore {objectLabel}
commandMenuItem.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: numberOfSelectedRecords >= 1 and (isSelectAll or everyDefined(selectedRecords, "deletedAt")) and objectPermissions.canSoftDeleteObjectRecords and (pageType == "RECORD_PAGE" or hasAnySoftDeleteFilterOnView) and (isSelectAll or noneEquals(selectedRecords, "recordPermissions.canSoftDelete", false))

commandMenuItem.label: Permanently destroy {objectLabel}
commandMenuItem.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: numberOfSelectedRecords >= 1 and objectPermissions.canDestroyObjectRecords and (isSelectAll or everyDefined(selectedRecords, "deletedAt")) and (pageType == "RECORD_PAGE" or hasAnySoftDeleteFilterOnView) and (isSelectAll or noneEquals(selectedRecords, "recordPermissions.canDelete", false))

commandMenuItem.label: Navigate to previous {objectLabelSingular}
commandMenuItem.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: pageType == "RECORD_PAGE" and not isInSidePanel and objectMetadataItem.nameSingular != "messageCampaign" and objectMetadataItem.nameSingular != "agentChatThread"

commandMenuItem.label: Edit Layout
commandMenuItem.conditionalAvailabilityExpression: pageType != "SETTINGS_PAGE" and not isLayoutCustomizationModeEnabled and permissionFlags.LAYOUTS
